purpose: Registration fragment for the ПростоСмета application. The catalog entry already exists in integrations/airlock-apps/apps.json, but the platform knows nothing about it: there is no agent row, no MCP resource, no binding and no credential. Merges into apps.json; the registry itself is read-only for this task and the application was not started.

app.name: ПростоСмета
app.agent_id_note: The agent does not exist yet. scripts/airlock_apps.py register creates it and injects the real id into the uploaded app.json; an id must never be written by hand.
app.ui_url_note: The adapter exposes MCP only and has no web interface of its own, so there is nothing to proxy through the UI gateway and no bridgeauth key is needed for this application.

principal.note: The binding carries no principal field on purpose: with a single binding and an empty principal the shared adapter serves it to every app admin (main.go bindingFor). A principal here would make the app answer 'Личное подключение для вашей учётной записи не настроено' to anyone else. The upstream simplysmeta.ru account belongs to the owner; the adapter logs in with it once and caches the JWT for one hour. The bearer that Airlock presents to the adapter is a separate token, not the simplysmeta.ru password.

platform_rule.text: binding.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN need.binding_mode='shared' THEN NULL ELSE $1::uuid END AND (m.owner_principal_id = creator.id OR EXISTS (resource_grants with 'use' for creator))
platform_rule.consequence: A shared MCP resource resolves only while its owner_principal_id equals the binding creator (binding.created_by_user_id), or the creator holds a 'use' grant.
platform_rule.verified_by: read-only SELECT on the sibling resources of the same family (Universal UserIO 365c1a4b, owner 5e438326, binding created_by 5e438326) -> the rule holds for the owner as creator.

notes: The catalog entry in apps.json is already complete and correct: its 7 operations are exactly the 7 tools the live adapter advertises, and the URL is the public ingress. Merging this fragment changes nothing in the catalog - it documents what the platform side still needs.

The three money-touching tools (simplysmeta_set_catalogs, simplysmeta_create_estimate, simplysmeta_calculate) are declared in apps.json WITHOUT mutation:true. That is deliberate: the shared adapter rejects every operation marked mutation:true inside service_read (main.go: 'Изменения требуют подтверждения в приложении'), so a mutation-flagged operation could never be called from the console. The adapter enforces its own gate instead and refuses to run without confirm:true in the arguments. The owner may decide to keep this contract or to change it.

The adapter is not part of the platform code base: it is a separate Go service on server-100 with its own systemd unit. The Airlock application is only the thin adapter that exposes the catalog operations as tools.
No credential was created for this fragment: the simplysmeta.ru login and password belong to the owner and are never written by an agent.
